about: Owner profile: the parameters the safety filter in docs/agent-guide.md runs on. Copy this file next to your inventory (outside the repo if your deployment is public), rename it to profile.json, and set the values to your own situation. The agent reads it before filtering; never assume another owner's walls are yours.
notes: All values in this example are fictional and purely illustrative: a UK-based owner without a credit card. Replace every value with your own situation.
